title: Story premise ENT062: The Giant Footprint Close-Up
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: Whatever made this has three terrible toes. Takeaway/theme: Scale and framing can change an interpretation.
description: A scout wants to identify a supposed giant after discovering an enormous three-toed print, but every proposed monster contradicts the next clue. The camera finally pulls back to show a tiny scout examining the end of a garden fork pressed into clay, and the scout updates the sketch to FORK.
